opening.argument: The visible sequence is an app walkthrough: it opens on Ludo Fantasy’s login and sign-up screen, proceeds through registration and OTP verification, and shows a practice match before reaching Add Money and payment options. The accompanying promotion offers a ₹10 referral bonus and says users can earn real money playing Ludo. Those are claims about the app and its advertised offer; the supplied material does not establish deception or a misleading financial outcome. The closing screen’s “play careful” message also provides a caution alongside the promotion. The record supports an explanation of how the app is presented and used, not a finding that viewers were misled or lost money.
